The Role:
Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights?
As an Analyst in the Analytics Research & Data (ARD) business unit at Fidelity Investments, you will play a pivotal role in driving data-driven decisions andstrategies. Your work will be instrumental in identifying opportunities to craft the future of our financial services, making a significant impact on both our clients and the business. • Demonstrate critical thinking and structured problem‑solving capabilities, with the ability to address the “so what” and “what if,” and recommend actions.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and concise manner
• Skilled in translating business questions into testable hypotheses and validating them through experimentation or advanced analytics.
• Ability to collaborate cross‑functionally, working effectively with diverse teams to align outcomes with organizational and customer goals.
• High curiosity, strong ownership mindset, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
• Support quantitative and qualitative primary research studies, conducting secondary research scans. Familiarity with research basics such as creating research briefs, questionnaire design, sampling, weighting, hypothesis testing.
The Team:
Analytics Research & Data (ARD) is a forward‑looking insights organization focused on anticipating client needs and predicting future behaviours through data, analytics, customer research, and AI‑driven solutions. As part of ARD, your work will play a critical role in shaping Fidelity’s future—enhancing client experiences, enabling smarter decisions, and building enduring customer relationships.

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar's mission lies in Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations acrossthe globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.
Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:
• SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
• Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
• IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
• Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
• Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
• Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.
How We Work
Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that's at home, in the office, or on the move.
We're a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You'll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.
Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren't just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.
Key Accountabilities and Duties
Accountabilities
• Reporting to Director of Datasets
• This role oversees production of energy market fundamental model components and standalone models working out of our Pune office using PLEXOS and Aurora
Day to day duties
• Lead a large team of energy data analysts (with between 1 to 5 years of experience)
• Responsible for ensuring the completion and delivery of accurate updates of specific fundamental data work products as part of PLEXOS and Aurora dataset development
• Responsible for leading power markets research, analyzing and manipulating data and processing data for input into power market models
• Benchmarking etc. end-to-end process of creation and upgrading of production cost models
• Responsible for maintaining large databases of energy related data. Data sources include data-providers, industry publications, regulatory agencies and web research.
• Running PLEXOS and/or Aurora and interpreting output model results and energy balances
• Comparing models and reviewing preliminary forecast output results for inconsistencies to ensure deliveries meet product scopes and specifications
• Communicate to IDC Analyst team about market modelling best practices and implementing improvements to research and model development
• Problem solving and interpretation of market models and ability to detect errors and omissions
• Troubleshoot market models and intermediate work products for errors, omissions, and improvements.
Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

Job Summary
This role is part of Business Integration and Compliance (BIC) team within Downstream Trading Renewables Service & Operations Management (DTR SOM). DTR SOM delivers Secure, Reliable and Affordable End to End IT operations to Shell s Downstream business. The current role is part of the transformation vertical which is a linking pin between the various DTR Operate Teams, delivering strategic initiatives and drive automation for meaningful data insights.
What s the role
The internal job title for this position is Systems Engineer. This role supports the IT Operations and Service Integration teams by leveraging data to generate actionable insights that drive operational excellence. The position focuses on data analytics, automation, and visualization, enabling informed decision-making, improving service performance, and fostering continuous improvement across IT services.
- Analyze large datasets from IT systems (e.g., ServiceNow, data platforms) to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
- Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI and other MS tools to support operational and management reporting.
- Support automation initiatives using Power Apps, Power Automate, and Python to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
- Experience with AI and AI agent technologies (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, or similar platforms), with the ability to design, configure, and deploy AI agents that automate workflows, enhance reporting, and support IT operational processes.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across IT operations to understand data requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
- Assist in improving data quality, governance, and standardisation across reporting processes.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aligned with simplification and automation principles.
What We Need from You
- Bachelor s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 3 to 5 years of experience in data analytics, automation, large-scale data management, AI agent technologies and data visualization solutions.
- Experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Python
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
- Solid understanding of IT Operations and ServiceNow Reports and Dashboards
- Certifications in ITIL and Agile methodologies is an added advantage
- Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess and optimize complex business processes.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with stakeholders across various levels of the organization.
